summary: Pull requests run only the 94 kit stories tagged critical, without axe and within a 420-second budget; merge groups and manual runs keep every story with the a11y check.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No application or API change. CI only: per-PR kit plays shrink to the critical set without axe; merge groups keep the full matrix with axe and every strict assertion. Stories gain a critical tag only.

recovery.detail: Revert the workflow environment to run all stories with a11y on.
